Business name: SaltHouse
Tagline: TBD (working: "Made well, made once")
What we sell: Women's clothing — knitwear, denim, simple staples. ~30 SKUs.

Target customer:
- Women 28–45
- Coastal cities — Boston, Portland ME, Portsmouth, Mystic
- Household income $80k–180k
- Owns 3+ "investment" pieces in current wardrobe
- Reads The Cut, House Beautiful

Brand vibes:
- Quiet
- Unfussy
- "Old money but not weird about it"
- Slightly New England maritime — but not literally fishing-themed

USPs / story:
- Limited drops, 4 per year
- Knitwear is made by a small mill in Northern Ireland
- Denim is selvedge, made in Japan
- Founder is Eliza Brand — former buyer at Toast (the brand)
- We do not run sales. Ever. Price is the price.

What we need:
- Homepage
- Product pages
- About + Story page
- Contact

Price point: Premium. Sweaters are $295–450.
